_description: Ö3 events (tools/extra_events.py; source belgeler/wiki/etkinlikler/). The sections are described in their modules.

chromin._source: hitac_chromin.json chromin: 160,000 limit, 1:7 honor at the end of the event, gates (Kappa, Epsilon, Zeta, Delta, Kuiper, Kronos; in gates.json streuner = Kuiper Gate), box types CHROMIN_BOX_1..3, 2,700 per gate for all six gates (darkorbitwiki chromin-rush, 2026-10-01)
chromin._adaptation: Per-alien quantity is the ratio of the gate total (2,700) to the alien's strength (HP + shield); 40% of aliens drop a box (quantity accordingly). 10 credits per Chromin over the limit (ratio not in the source). Box size by quantity (thresholds 150, 600).

hitac_lottery._source: hitac_chromin.json: HITAC 5 letters, always a missing letter; Minion box 50% letter and 300 MCB-50; Underling 0.5%, Underboss 18%; 1 capsule from the mothership box; converter 2024-2026 table (40 packages, total 100%). Letter probabilities: {"Hitac-Minion cargo box (classic Hitac event 2012-2015)": 50.0, "HITAC MINION box (Hitac Assault, Hitac 2.0 / 2.5 motherships)": null, "Easy Hitac Minion box (low-level version)": null, "Hitac Underling (X-2..X-8)": 0.5, "Hitac Underboss (X-2..X-8)": 18.0, "HITAC MOTHERSHIP box (darkorbitwiki)": null}
hitac_lottery._adaptation: Box types are the client's names (HITAC_MINION, HITAC_UNDERBOSS, HITAC). A box drops every time an Underling and an Underboss dies: a letter with the wiki chance, and next to it a row from the contents with equal weight (items from darkorbitwiki hitac-assault; quantities and chance not in the source: adaptation). The mothership box gives 50 ACM-1 and 1,000 PLT-3030 (wiki) next to the capsule; Backup Shield 2, Battle Repair Bot 2, Explosive Charging Blob and NPC Nuke 5% each (chance not in the source: adaptation). end_draw: wiki "end-of-event lottery (used capsules)", reward count 3 packages per sample; in single-player, as the draw's only participant, each capsule spent at the Capsule Converter is one entry, and each entry gives up to 3 unowned rewards from the pool (probability not in the source: equal). The capsule's uridium price is in the shop balance.

title_hunt.title: title_titlefrenzy_event2026
title_hunt._source: hitac_chromin.json title_frenzy: 4 titles, X-2..X-8 Underlings, hours, loss conditions, 2024-2026 ranking rewards (each rank also gets the permanent title), sets 12-20 and 22-30 August 2026
title_hunt._adaptation: Rivals are virtual (the names of the auction rivals): each minute an 8% chance to grab the title from the alien, holding it for 5-25 min. The score is the minutes held. The two sets are like a single period (two ranges in the calendar; each gives its own reward).

fever._source: diger_etkinlikler.json fever: hours (weekdays 19-21, weekends 13-15 and 19-21), Galactic Strife 09-2020 team (same as the client's texts), free repair at base or the nearest portal on death; Black Light Fever sets (sets): darkorbitwiki eternal-black-light (17-23 September and 25 September - 1 October 2026)
fever._adaptation: In the original game on PvP maps: in single-player Hitac's normal maps (X-2..X-8), Black Light and Gauntlet of Plutus; alien damage instead of damage to the player's ship. Black Light weeks (fever_black_light calendar) with their own set and only on BL maps; repeats once a year (every 52 weeks).

fiesta._source: fiesta_gate.json: 5 difficulties (voucher 1/5/10/15/23, AP 5/30/60/100/160), unlocked in order, single life, the voucher is lost on failure; 50-level AP track (total 9,600); completion rewards (darkorbitwiki probabilities); aliens Chronospire, Veil Stalker and Trinity Trials' Pyrospire, Magma Stalker, Vinespire, Spore Stalker
fiesta._adaptation: Map per difficulty (494-498: Tranquil..Mythic). Waves (6/8/10/12/15) and alien counts are adaptation; the aliens' HP/shield are the Trinity Trials tiers (easy..nightmare: the Mythic values are the same as the wiki), the rewards are between the wiki's Standard and Mythic values. The portal's appearance is the Birthday Gate's (15).

galaxy_trek._source: galaxy_trek.json: 40 planets / 8 regions, exploration 1 FTL Key (1/5/10), events 50%/30%/20% (+3%/5%/9%) and 2026-09 reward packages, 13 steps (Stellar Raider 16, Starfield Vanquisher 36, 40: 2x LF-5 Mortifier), 16 quests (total 60 keys), 10 quests per day (1 fixed, 9 random); the keys are deleted when the event ends
galaxy_trek._adaptation: Progress above 100% does not carry over to the next planet (not in the source). 100,000 uridium instead of the "1 Month Premium" step (always Premium in single-player). Progress resets every run (low confidence in the source). Fixed quest entry.

infiltration._source: diger_etkinlikler.json infiltration: 10 minutes, hidden commandos (do not fire), become visible when hit, more reward than ordinary aliens, not on X-1, evening rounds 19-22, Thanksgiving 24 November - 5 December; hidden Boss Kristallon (when found and destroyed gives Uber Kristallon's loot; fandom Infiltration)
infiltration._adaptation: Team of 6 aliens (no source), reward 2x (sources 2x/4x), 2 min between rounds; types Saimon, Mordon, Sibelonit, Kristallin, Protegit, Kristallon, Interceptor (the examples in the source); the team is on the map of the player's company. The hidden Boss Kristallon (npc.json event_infiltration_boss_kristallon) takes the place of a commando in 25% of rounds (no probability in the source).

invasion._source: diger_etkinlikler.json invasion: gates X-1 (5-9), X-3 (10-14), X-5 (15+), 22 waves (Streuner .. Boss Kucurbium; then it starts over), 1 point per alien for the company, the winning companies get +10%/+5%/+3% damage for 1 week, exit only by dying, free repair; Kucurbium values darkorbitwiki
invasion._adaptation: Maps by company and tier (61-69: MMO/EIC/VRU in that order). Wave counts, tier multipliers (HP/shield/damage x1/x2/x3; the reward is the same in every tier: official forum 127530), Uber Sibelon / Kristallon instead of the "SaNeJiEwZ" waves. The other companies' score is virtual (20-60 per minute); the player's company also gets a virtual team score, each player kill +1. The damage reward is the DMG-B01 booster (168 / 84 / 48 hours). Kucurbium's appearance is Curcubitor's.
invasion._forum_tr: Official Turkish forum 127530 (Invasion Map): rewards are equal across tiers (x1/x1.5/x2 removed); Boss Kucurbium has Insta-Shield while its minions are alive (permanent)

urgent_quests._source: diger_etkinlikler.json urgent_missions: appears after a long uninterrupted alien hunt, accepted only at base, disappears when time runs out, the targets are ordinary aliens (example 2 Streuner, 2 Lordakia, 2 Mordon)
urgent_quests._adaptation: After 45 min of continuous play and 150 kills (at most once an hour), 20 min duration, 2-4 each of the map's 3 types; the reward is 3 times the targets' rewards (in the original game it compensated for the decreasing rewards; there is no decreasing reward on the server).

galactic_strife._source: darkorbitwiki events/galactic-strife (2026-09-16); client texts galacticStrife_* (fever: double gain, free repair)
galactic_strife._adaptation: the per-kill formula is not published (only 'the smaller the difference, the more reputation; too large, none'): Elo-like gain = 2k(1-E), E = 1/(1+10^((loser-winner)/400)), 20 between equals, 0 when the winner leads by more than max_gap; the loser loses the same base; a repeated victim of the day divides the gain by (1 + earlier kills); bots keep their own reputation in their profile
galactic_strife._crates: wiki: Flux +10% speed for a short duration (not above 750; cannot be picked up while active), Mire -20% speed to nearby enemy ships (not party members; P.E.T. collectors cannot pick them up). Adaptation: 2 + 2 crates per map, 60 s respawn, Flux 30 s, Mire 800 units for 10 s

team_deathmatch._source: darkorbitwiki events/team-death-match (2022-06-08): level bands 8-13 / 14+, X-1 battlemaster, three matches MMO-EIC / EIC-VRU / MMO-VRU, 8 per team (the client's text: at least 3 per side), 15 min or 100 points, +1 per kill, 3 lives, 20 s start phase, free repair at the TDM spawn within 15 s of the death (flashres: after that the pilot is removed from the TDM server) and 20 s protection after it, a draw: both lose, 30 s without opponents: no reward, result window 30 s, reward by kills and a loser reward when kills <= deaths, the winning company +10% ore price / bonus box (not energy) / EP from kills for 24 h; maps-config.xml 81 TDM I level 8, 82 TDM II level 14; flashres tdm_* texts; belgeler/arastirma/PVP_MODLARI.md section 1
team_deathmatch._adaptation: not published: the reward amounts (kill tiers 1 / 5 / 10 / 20, loser reward), the confirmation seconds (20), the queue fill speed (a bot every 2-6 s, at least 3 per side after 45 s), the spawn points (left and right middle of the map), the start-zone radius (1,200), the battlemaster position (1,500 from the X-1 station towards the middle); the other pilots are the band's bot players; the matches without the player are simulated (lobby rows, event score); TDM II's top level is the level cap (the lobby title shows min - max); when the band has too few bot pilots (a young pack), the company's bots of the nearest level fill the team; the bots take the free repair 3-10 s after their death

sector_control._source: darkorbitwiki events/sector-control (2022-06-13) and the official Turkish FAQ board-tr 127679: groups 8-13 (map 201 SC-1) and 14+ (map 202 SC-2), the beacon near the middle of X-1, at most 15 per company, start with 5 pilots in two companies, 30 s countdown in the start area, constant ticket bleed, a kill = 1 ticket of the victim's company, the control point bleed table, 5 times faster bleed after 15 minutes, capture: more pilots than the holder, each extra pilot faster up to 8, a tie keeps the holder, cloaked pilots do not count, back to the holder / neutral when the attackers leave; the start area repairs 10,000 HP/s and cannot be captured; underdog bonus +5% (2 points behind), +8% (3), +15% (all 4 held); free respawn at the start area within 15 s with the in-place repair's protection; the door leaves without the bonus; a company without tickets is out; the winners get kill statistics and the EP & Honor bonus (flashres msg_sectorcontrol_kill_statistics); client: minLevel / maxLevel 999 shows infinity, captureThreshold 1000
sector_control._adaptation: not published: 500 tickets (the old fandom value; the wiki gives no number), bleed 0.1 ticket/s plus 0.1 per point of difference to each holder, capture 20 s with one pilot and 1.5 s less per extra pilot, the start area and control point positions (a triangle of start areas, four points around the middle) and radii (900 / 650), the beacon 1,200 left of the X-1's middle, two lobby matches per group, the bots fill each company to 10 (performance), confirmation 20 s, the bots take the free respawn after 3-10 s and engage enemies within 900, the bonus 10% per kill (at most 100%) of the EP and Honor earned in the match; the bot pilots of the nearest levels fill a young pack; the calendar is the Thanksgiving mini event window (no published Sector Control dates)

spaceball._source: darkorbitwiki events/space-ball (2022-08-10): the ball on 4-4, shoot it to your company's portal to its X-5, a goal gives cargo prizes (457 SAB-50, 241 UCB-100, 48 PLT-2021, 149 uridium, 10 extra energy, 3 repair vouchers, 2 jump vouchers), next-day company bonuses (examples: 10% EP, 5% cargo selling, 2% bonus boxes); fandom Spaceball: the prizes are in cargo boxes, the quicker one takes them; client: SpaceBall* commands, box type FROM_SPACEBALL, models 442-444, msg_spaceball_company_scored
spaceball._adaptation: not published: the ball heads for the portal of the company with the most damage in the last 10 s, speed 1-3 (80 / 130 / 180) by its lead; the goal radius 450; one box per prize (120 s); the bots near the ball shoot it; the day's winner (most goals, no tie) gets the wiki's example bonus for 24 hours; the model by season

capture_the_beacon._source: darkorbitwiki events/capture-the-beacon (2022-06-08): two beacons on every company's X-2 in the colours of the other two, steal the one of your colour on an enemy X-2 and deliver it to the matching place on your own X-2 for a point, it returns to its map, the cloak goes off while carrying, killing the carrier stops it, your own map's beacons cannot be taken, level 13, the company with the most deliveries wins; board-tr 127523; the client's breakingNewsContent_springfight_ctb (a tournament every hour); client CTB* commands (beacon id 1xy), ctbHomeZone_<id>
capture_the_beacon._adaptation: not published: taking and delivering by flying into the zone (radius 450; the beacon at rest has no model to click in this client), the beacon of a killed carrier goes home at once (no model to lie on the map), the carrier 25% slower, the zone positions (two per X-2, away from the portals), an enemy bot raid on the player's X-2 every 4-8 minutes, the other deliveries of the hour simulated (one every 5-15 minutes), the hour winner's prize +5% EP and Honor for the next hour
